snippet.title: Reverie in the Moonlight - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
▼Steam (Release: 2025 TBC)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3480790/

I wish this dream would never end. I'm sure you're wishing for the same thing.

Reverie in the Moonlight is an action game where you play chase against monsters.

Get safely through this long night with the help of many unique plush toys.
Tete, the protagonist, hasn't been getting a good night's sleep in a long time because of the monsters in his nightmares.

One night, he meets Luna, a mysterious girl who teaches him how to fight back against the monsters with the plushies' help...
